Pinter et al. have described that EGFR mutations in lung adenocarcinomas are not consistently accompa- nied by EGFR protein positivity by standard immunohis- tochemistry [45]. They reported that some of the EGFR mutant patients with major clinical response to gefitinib or erlotinib showed negative EGFR immunostaining [45]. Other studies have also noted such disagreement between EGFR immunoexpression and presence of mutations detected via molecular diagnostic methods [37,46]. These results suggest the importance of molecu- lar diagnostic methods to identify EGFR mutations and subsequently those who will benefit from EGFR inhibi- tor therapy.
